d: Join Snoonu as an Employee Relations Lead – Onboarding & Offboarding, where you will lead and oversee the end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding processes across Snoonu Fleet, ensuring a seamless, efficient, compliant, and positive employee lifecycle experience. You will be responsible for managing onboarding and offboarding operations and ensuring that employee documentation, employment formalities, system updates, clearances, and related administrative requirements are completed accurately and within established timelines. Working closely with Talent Acquisition, PRO, Payroll, Finance, IT, Fleet Operations, and other relevant stakeholders, you will ensure that new joiners are properly integrated into the business and employee exits are managed professionally, with all legal, financial, and operational requirements fulfilled. The role requires strong leadership, operational follow-up, stakeholder coordination, and process improvement capabilities to support Fleet's large and continuously evolving workforce while maintaining compliance with Qatar Labour Law and Snoonu's internal policies.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
5–7 years of experience in Employee Relations, HR Operations, onboarding, offboarding, or employee lifecycle management, preferably within a large-scale or operational workforce environment.
Previous experience leading or supervising a team is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of employee onboarding and offboarding processes, employment documentation, final settlements, employee clearances, and HR administration.
Good knowledge of Qatar Labour Law, employment regulations, and relevant government procedures.
Experience coordinating with Payroll, Finance, PRO, Talent Acquisition, and Operations teams.
Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple operational requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and HRIS platforms such as Keka or similar systems.
High level of professionalism, accountability, integrity, and confidentiality.
Fluency in English is required; Arabic is considered an advantage.

Lead and manage end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes for Snoonu Fleet employees, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant execution.
li
Oversee employment documentation, contracts, QID processing, sponsorship transfers, insurance registration, employee records, and other joining formalities.
li
Manage employee resignations, terminations, final clearances, company asset returns, and exit documentation.
li
Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, and PRO to ensure timely processing of outstanding salaries, final settlements, End-of-Service Benefits (EOS), QID cancellations, and other exit formalities.
li
Lead and supervise the onboarding and offboarding team, ensuring effective task distribution, productivity, accountability, and achievement of SLAs.
li
Coordinate with Talent Acquisition, PRO, Payroll, Finance, IT, and Fleet Operations to ensure seamless employee lifecycle processes.
li
Ensure compliance with Qatar Labour Law, government requirements, and internal company policies and procedures.
li
Monitor onboarding and offboarding progress, resolve operational bottlenecks, and escalate pending cases and critical issues when required.
li
Maintain accurate employee records, HRIS updates, documentation, trackers, and operational reports.
li
Monitor team performance and key operational KPIs, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions.
li
Develop and improve onboarding and offboarding procedures, workflows, and controls to enhance efficiency and employee experience.
li
Provide regular management updates on operational performance, pending cases, compliance risks, and improvement initiatives.
